## Webhook proxy → framer-cms-sync
For pushing from a laptop or an agent to a container that isn't exposed to the internet.
POST `{ op, sync, payload, planId?, publish?, slug?, redirectTo? }`. `payload` is the body for plan/apply (e.g. `{ posts: [{ slug, markdown }] }`).
Protect the webhook with Header Auth, and use a framer-cms-sync token with the smallest scope that works.
